==== SCENE CONTEXT ====
A 12-second suspense short. One single continuous story.
Uma cozinha escura.
Um gato olha o peixe.
Ele pula.
Pure visual storytelling. NO dialogue.

==== ACTIVE REFERENCES ====
NONE. Text-only generation.
The ART STYLE is fully described in STYLE below.
ALL characters, props and the location are defined below.
KEEP every design IDENTICAL from first frame to last.

==== CHARACTERS ====
THE CAT — "SHADOW"
Black cat, yellow eyes
Red collar
Personality: patient

THE FISH
Orange goldfish in a round bowl
A round glass bowl
Personality: oblivious

==== LOCATION MAP ====
Dentro de uma cozinha pequena.
Uma mesa com um aquário.
The cat on FRAME LEFT

==== SCALE LOCK ====
The bowl is twice the cat's head.

==== CONTINUITY ====
Same location, same time of day, same light direction in every shot.
Character designs NEVER change.
Wardrobe and colors NEVER change.
The collar stays RED.
The bowl never moves.

==== FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING ====
The kitchen.
The bowl on the table.

==== FORMAT MODE ====
1:1 square.
HARD CUTS at: 0:04 / 0:08

==== OPTICS ====
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04): 18mm overhead wide
SHOT 2 (0:04–0:08): 50mm medium
SHOT 3 (0:08–0:11): 35mm two-shot

==== CAMERA ====
SHOT 1: Crane up to reveal the whole scene.
SHOT 2: Gentle handheld drift.
SHOT 3: Whip pan between the characters.

==== ACTION ====
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04)
In frame: ONLY THE CAT, THE FISH.
The cat stares at the bowl.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:08)
In frame: ONLY THE FISH.
The fish swims in circles.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 (0:08–0:11)
The cat jumps.
Hold.

==== PERFORMANCE ====
Exaggerated, readable cartoon acting.
Big, clear facial expressions.
Snappy comedic timing with a pause before each punch.

==== SURFACE DETAIL ====
Walls, ground and props painted with soft, simplified brushwork.
Foliage and fabric as brushy shapes, not fine detail.
Painterly finish on every surface, NOT photoreal.

==== PHYSICS ====
Cartoon physics with real weight.
Slight squash on impact and stretch on acceleration.
Light objects drift and scatter in the wake of fast movement.

==== LIGHTING ====
Hard moonlight from the window.
Thin mist on the floor.

==== COLOR GRADE ====
Warm oranges, peach and rust against cool blue-violet shadows.
Rich but soft saturation.

==== STYLE ====
Flat vector look.
Bold shapes.
Characters have big faces.
NO readable text anywhere in frame.
NO text overlays.
NO subtitles.
NO watermark.
NO logos.

==== OUTPUT SETTINGS ====
1:1.
12 seconds.
3 shots with HARD CUTS at the listed timestamps.
Clean, smooth animation. No flicker.

==== FINAL POSITIVE LOCKS ====
THE CAT, THE FISH stay IDENTICAL from first frame to last.

meta:
You are a director writing a prompt for a text-to-video AI model that makes short animated films.
Turn the IDEA below into one complete prompt. The idea may be written in Portuguese; write the prompt in English.

Use EXACTLY these sections, in this order, each one headed as ==== NAME ====:
SCENE CONTEXT / ACTIVE REFERENCES / CHARACTERS / LOCATION MAP / SCALE LOCK / CONTINUITY / FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING / FORMAT MODE / OPTICS / CAMERA / ACTION / PERFORMANCE / SURFACE DETAIL / PHYSICS / LIGHTING / COLOR GRADE / STYLE / OUTPUT SETTINGS / FINAL POSITIVE LOCKS

Rules:
- Short declarative lines, one fact per line. No paragraphs.
- Put the few things that must not fail in CAPITALS (colors, counts, sizes, NO/NEVER rules).
- CHARACTERS: for each one give body and face, outfit with exact colors, vehicle or prop, and personality.
- LOCATION MAP: describe the place like a map, then say from which side of the frame each character enters.
- SCALE LOCK and CONTINUITY: state relative sizes and everything that never changes between shots.
- Split the 12 seconds into 5 to 8 shots. Give every shot a time range, one lens (OPTICS), one camera move (CAMERA) and one clear action (ACTION). End each shot with HARD CUT. and the last one with Hold.
- The story needs a setup, an escalation and a final turn that lands in the last two shots.
- STYLE ends with: NO text overlays. NO subtitles. NO watermark. NO logos.
- FINAL POSITIVE LOCKS repeats, in five or six lines, the style, the light, the key colors and the ending.
- Output only the prompt.

Fixed settings:
Format: 1:1 square. Duration: 12 seconds. Tone: suspense. Pure visual storytelling. NO dialogue.

STYLE to use:
Flat vector look.
Bold shapes.
Characters have big faces.

LIGHTING to use:
Hard moonlight from the window.
Thin mist on the floor.

IDEA:
Uma cozinha escura.
Um gato olha o peixe.
Ele pula.
